contextual_checks.label: pil_beam_edge_direct
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Exact pixel-class overlap can be measured with PIL HSV; H uses 0..255, not OpenCV 0..179. No rounded H conversion. Column/row/run/line acceptance must be checked separately.

contextual_checks.label: relative_white_marker
contextual_checks.expression: w=min(R,G,B); valid=lens_valid; k=clip(.25*sqrt(region_area_px2),15,151)|1; wb=OPEN(where(valid,w,255),rect(k,k)); sb=CLOSE(where(valid & (V>=50),S,0),rect(k,k)); mask=inner & valid & (w>=1.3*wb) & (w-wb>=12) & (S<=.78*sb); OPEN(mask,3x3); remove components touching inner edge
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Frame/region-relative local contrast, lens support and component topology. Evaluate complete detector on own RGB/JPEG with the same region candidate; no fixed HSV interval or all-texture zero claim.

contextual_checks.label: relative_handle_dark
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Relative brightness plus colored-cargo adjacency and morphology. The V<=86.7/S<=90 bound is only a mathematical superset because frame V75<=255; its raw hits are not a handle false-positive verdict.

contextual_checks.label: relative_peer_materials
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Grey floor/wall pixels can intentionally match the grey intermediate class; dark upper envelope is V<=96.9. Check complete peer/object judgment and candidate regions, not zero overlap with intermediate material classes.

contextual_checks.label: paint_item_contrast_hue_signature
contextual_checks.expression: ring_median_bgr=median(ring.BGR); centre_delta=max(abs(centre.BGR-ring_median_bgr),axis=channel); differing=centre_delta>38; close=OR((H>=lo-8)&(H<=hi+8) for lo,hi in APPEARANCE[kind].hue); bright=V>=28; kind_share=mean(differing & close & bright); no S floor
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Hue-only intermediate signature is combined with local BGR contrast and projected region support. Raw hue hits alone are not fixed cargo-color false positives. Use complete judgment on own-camera frames.

contextual_checks.label: active_wall_free_floor_support
contextual_checks.expression: For columns with finite observed wall bottom vb, sample rows from ceil(vb)+3 to HEIGHT-4 in steps of 12; keep samples with S<=128 and V>=30; project only these below-contact samples
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Intended floor/free-space support; matching neutral floor pixels is expected. Compare support retention and false free-space reports; no zero overlap requirement.

contextual_checks.label: rgb_vo_support
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Intended own-camera visual odometry support with calibration/self-mask geometry. Compare surviving keypoints/track validity and motion error; floor/wall raw support hits are not target-color overlap.

contextual_checks.label: visual_fix_flow_support
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Intended neutral-scene flow support. Check track availability/accuracy; overlap with support is not a foreground false positive.

contextual_checks.label: checkpoint_visual_floor_support
contextual_checks.expression: mask=valid_pixel_mask(1)&(S<=150)&(V>=90); intersect with calibrated forward/downward floor-plane ray support and max planar range .8m
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Intended floor feature support. Compare retained features and floor-plane correctness separately; neutral raw hits are expected.

contextual_checks.label: goal_floor_ring_and_explicit_options
contextual_checks.expression: goal=(H in options.hue interval)&(S>=options.saturation_min)&(V>=options.value_min)&valid; floor_support=(S<=options.floor_saturation_max)&(V>=options.value_min)&valid; ring=dilate(component,3x3)&~component; support=mean(floor_support on ring)
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Baseline fixed goal HSV is already in the main table. v2/v3 allow explicit frozen DEV options, so record actual supplied options for each camera comparison. Floor-ring support intentionally overlaps neutral floor; no universal bound over arbitrary caller options.

contextual_checks.label: opencv_wall_occluder_and_uniform_band
contextual_checks.expression: saturated=dilate(inRange(HSV,(0,wall_band_saturation_max,30),(179,255,255)),5x5)>0; reject a wall band touching saturated pixels; require one candidate per column; legacy detector std=sqrt(var(strip_mean_luminance)+var(strip_mean_(B-R)))<=3 plus contrast and geometry tests
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Wall/occluder and uniform-band acceptance is not a cargo-color range. Preserve baseline or use a separately named, calibrated v2 adapter; actual values/config hashes must accompany camera evaluation.

contextual_checks.label: hsi_wall_floor_histogram_support
contextual_checks.expression: filtered=GaussianBlur(BGR,5x5); I=(R+G+B)/3 in [0,1]; S_HSI=1-min(R,G,B)/max(I,1e-12); hue=atan2(sqrt(3)*(G-B),2*R-G-B) mod 2pi; valid_hue=(I>10/255)&(S_HSI>.1); obstacle=((valid_hue & (reference_hue_hist[Hbin]<60))|(reference_intensity_hist[Ibin]<80)) & support
contextual_checks.validation_scope: HSI/current reference histograms and calibration support, not fixed OpenCV HSV intervals. Validate full boundary/contact output against baseline; no texture-wide zero overlap claim.

contextual_checks.label: lorigo_window_histogram_support
contextual_checks.expression: resize BGR to 64x64; normalizedRGB=BGR/sum(BGR); float OpenCV HSV: hue/360 and saturation; set hue/saturation bins to -1 when S<.033; 32-bin edge/normalizedR/normalizedG/H/S features; compare 20x10-window histograms to own current-frame bottom reference with L1 thresholds [80,80,80], median fusion
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Appearance/window reference contact estimator; no fixed semantic wall/cargo class. Evaluate final contacts/false boundaries; raw feature bins are not subject to zero overlap.

contextual_checks.label: heading_background_difference
contextual_checks.validation_scope: Additional HSV entries measure only the hard or nonzero soft color supersets; complete estimator requires background difference and subsequent component/fit conditions. No assertion that raw color hits alone equal final false detections.
